plugin.name: ElevenLabs
plugin.description: Generate speech, sound effects and music, and transcribe audio.
plugin.longDescription: Optional Beta for your ElevenLabs API account. Includes account voice search and previews, speech, sound effects, music and Scribe transcription. Generated audio uses recoverable paid-step receipts. Requires OhMyGame API 2.21; existing built-in settings are not migrated by installing this plugin.
provider.name: ElevenLabs (plugin)
config.key.title: ElevenLabs API key
config.key.description: Create an API key in your ElevenLabs account. Voice browsing needs read access; speech, sound effects, music and transcription need their respective access. Generation uses your account credits.
